Subset.subject: Applied Sciences
Subset.question: The _____ was Set whose elements all belong to another set.
Subset.fact: In mathematics, a set A is a subset of a set B if and only if all elements of A are also elements of B; B is then a superset of A. It is possible for A and B to be equal; if they are unequal, then A is a proper subset of B. The relationship of one set being a subset of another is called inclusion (or sometimes containment). A is a subset of B may also be expressed as B includes (or contains) A or A is included (or contained) in B. A k-subset is a subset with k elements.

Waffen-SS.question: On 11 May, the SS-VT _____ crossed into the Netherlands south of the rivers and headed towards Breda
Waffen-SS.fact: On 11 May, the SS-VT Division crossed into the Netherlands south of the rivers and headed towards Breda. The rest of the SS-VT Division joined the northern front against the forces in Antwerp.

Waffen-SS.subject: Applied Sciences
Waffen-SS.question: The rest of the SS-VT _____ joined the northern front against the forces in Antwerp
Waffen-SS.fact: On 11 May, the SS-VT Division crossed into the Netherlands south of the rivers and headed towards Breda. The rest of the SS-VT Division joined the northern front against the forces in Antwerp.

Waffen-SS.subject: Applied Sciences
Waffen-SS.question: It fought a series of skirmishes before _____ advanced into the Dutch province of Zeeland on 14 May
Waffen-SS.fact: It fought a series of skirmishes before Germania advanced into the Dutch province of Zeeland on 14 May.

Waffen-SS.subject: Applied Sciences
Waffen-SS.question: On the same day, the _____ entered Rotterdam
Waffen-SS.fact: On the same day, the Leibstandarte entered Rotterdam. After the surrender of Rotterdam, the Leibstandarte left for The Hague, which they reached on 15 May, capturing 3,500 Dutch soldiers as prisoners of war.

Waffen-SS.subject: Applied Sciences
Waffen-SS.question: After the surrender of _____, the Leibstandarte left for The Hague, which they reached on 15 May, capturing 3,500 Dutch soldiers as prisoners of war
Waffen-SS.fact: On the same day, the Leibstandarte entered Rotterdam. After the surrender of Rotterdam, the Leibstandarte left for The Hague, which they reached on 15 May, capturing 3,500 Dutch soldiers as prisoners of war.

Waffen-SS.subject: Applied Sciences
Waffen-SS.question: In France, the SS _____ was involved in the only Allied tank counterattack in the Battle of France
Waffen-SS.fact: In France, the SS Totenkopf Division was involved in the only Allied tank counterattack in the Battle of France.

Waffen-SS.subject: Applied Sciences
Waffen-SS.question: On 21 May, units of the 1st _____, supported by the 50th (Northumbrian) Infantry Division, took part in the Battle of Arras
Waffen-SS.fact: On 21 May, units of the 1st Army Tank Brigade, supported by the 50th (Northumbrian) Infantry Division, took part in the Battle of Arras.

Waffen-SS.subject: Applied Sciences
Waffen-SS.question: The SS _____, on the southern flank of the 7th Panzer Division, was overrun, finding their standard anti-tank gun, the 3.7 cm PaK 36, was no match for the British Matilda II tank
Waffen-SS.fact: In France, the SS Totenkopf Division was involved in the only Allied tank counterattack in the Battle of France. The SS Totenkopf, on the southern flank of the 7th Panzer Division, was overrun, finding their standard anti-tank gun, the 3.7 cm PaK 36, was no match for the British Matilda II tank.

Waffen-SS.subject: Applied Sciences
Waffen-SS.question: After the Dutch surrender, the _____ moved south to France on 24 May
Waffen-SS.fact: After the Dutch surrender, the Leibstandarte moved south to France on 24 May.

Waffen-SS.subject: Applied Sciences
Waffen-SS.question: Becoming part of the XIX Panzer Corps under the command of General Heinz Guderian, they took up a position _____ south west of Dunkirk along the line of the Aa Canal, facing the Allied defensive line
Waffen-SS.fact: Becoming part of the XIX Panzer Corps under the command of General Heinz Guderian, they took up a position 15 miles south west of Dunkirk along the line of the Aa Canal, facing the Allied defensive line near Watten.

Waffen-SS.subject: Applied Sciences
Waffen-SS.question: A patrol from the SS-VT _____ crossed the canal at Saint-Venant, but was destroyed by British armour
Waffen-SS.fact: The SS Totenkopf, on the southern flank of the 7th Panzer Division, was overrun, finding their standard anti-tank gun, the 3.7 cm PaK 36, was no match for the British Matilda II tank. A patrol from the SS-VT Division crossed the canal at Saint-Venant, but was destroyed by British armour.

Waffen-SS.subject: Applied Sciences
Waffen-SS.question: A larger force from the SS-VT _____ then crossed the canal and formed a bridgehead at Saint-Venant; 30 miles from Dunkirk
Waffen-SS.fact: A patrol from the SS-VT Division crossed the canal at Saint-Venant, but was destroyed by British armour. A larger force from the SS-VT Division then crossed the canal and formed a bridgehead at Saint-Venant; 30 miles from Dunkirk.

Waffen-SS.subject: Applied Sciences
Waffen-SS.question: On that same day, _____ forces attacked Saint-Venant, forcing the SS-VT Division to retreat
Waffen-SS.fact: However, on the following day, in defiance of Hitler's orders, Dietrich ordered his 3rd Battalion to cross the canal and take the heights beyond, where British artillery observers were putting the regiment at risk. On that same day, British forces attacked Saint-Venant, forcing the SS-VT Division to retreat.

Waffen-SS.subject: Applied Sciences
Waffen-SS.question: On 26 May, the _____ advance resumed
Waffen-SS.fact: On 26 May, the German advance resumed.

Waffen-SS.subject: Applied Sciences
Waffen-SS.question: On 27 May, the _____ of the SS-VT Division reached the Allied defensive line on the Leie River at Merville
Waffen-SS.fact: On 27 May, the Deutschland Regiment of the SS-VT Division reached the Allied defensive line on the Leie River at Merville.

Waffen-SS.subject: Applied Sciences
Waffen-SS.question: The SS-VT managed to hold on against the British tank force, which got to within _____ (4.6 m) of commander Felix Steiner's position
Waffen-SS.fact: The SS-VT managed to hold on against the British tank force, which got to within 15 ft (4.6 m) of commander Felix Steiner's position.

Waffen-SS.subject: Applied Sciences
Waffen-SS.question: Only the arrival of the _____äger platoon saved the Deutschland Regiment from being destroyed and their bridgehead lost
Waffen-SS.fact: Only the arrival of the Totenkopf Panzerjäger platoon saved the Deutschland Regiment from being destroyed and their bridgehead lost.

Waffen-SS.subject: Applied Sciences
Waffen-SS.question: That same day, as the SS _____ advanced near Merville, they encountered stubborn resistance from British Army units, which slowed their advance
Waffen-SS.fact: That same day, as the SS Totenkopf Division advanced near Merville, they encountered stubborn resistance from British Army units, which slowed their advance.

Waffen-SS.subject: Applied Sciences
Waffen-SS.question: By 28 May, the _____ had taken the village of Wormhout, only ten miles from Dunkirk
Waffen-SS.fact: By 28 May, the Leibstandarte had taken the village of Wormhout, only ten miles from Dunkirk. It was there that troops of the Leibstandarte's 2nd Battalion committed the Wormhoudt massacre, where 81 British and French prisoners of war were murdered.

Waffen-SS.subject: Applied Sciences
Waffen-SS.question: It was there that troops of the _____'s 2nd Battalion committed the Wormhoudt massacre, where 81 British and French prisoners of war were murdered
Waffen-SS.fact: By 28 May, the Leibstandarte had taken the village of Wormhout, only ten miles from Dunkirk. It was there that troops of the Leibstandarte's 2nd Battalion committed the Wormhoudt massacre, where 81 British and French prisoners of war were murdered.

Waffen-SS.subject: Applied Sciences
Waffen-SS.question: After their surrender, soldiers from the 2nd Battalion, _____, along with some other units (including French soldiers), were taken to a barn in La Plaine au Bois near Wormhout and Esquelbecq
Waffen-SS.fact: After their surrender, soldiers from the 2nd Battalion, Royal Warwickshire Regiment, along with some other units (including French soldiers), were taken to a barn in La Plaine au Bois near Wormhout and Esquelbecq.

Waffen-SS.subject: Applied Sciences
Waffen-SS.question: By 30 May, the _____ were cornered at Dunkirk, and the SS divisions continued the advance into France
Waffen-SS.fact: It was there that troops of the Leibstandarte's 2nd Battalion committed the Wormhoudt massacre, where 81 British and French prisoners of war were murdered. By 30 May, the British were cornered at Dunkirk, and the SS divisions continued the advance into France.

Waffen-SS.subject: Applied Sciences
Waffen-SS.question: The Leibstandarte reached Saint-Étienne, _____ south of Paris, and had advanced further into France than any other unit
Waffen-SS.fact: The Leibstandarte reached Saint-Étienne, 250 miles south of Paris, and had advanced further into France than any other unit.

Waffen-SS.subject: Applied Sciences
Waffen-SS.question: German forces arrived in Paris unopposed on 14 June and _____ formally surrendered on 25 June
Waffen-SS.fact: By 30 May, the British were cornered at Dunkirk, and the SS divisions continued the advance into France. The Leibstandarte reached Saint-Étienne, 250 miles south of Paris, and had advanced further into France than any other unit.

Waffen-SS.subject: Applied Sciences
Waffen-SS.question: Himmler gained approval for the Waffen-SS to form its own high command, the Kommandoamt der Waffen-SS within the SS Führungshauptamt, which was created in August _____
Waffen-SS.fact: Himmler gained approval for the Waffen-SS to form its own high command, the Kommandoamt der Waffen-SS within the SS Führungshauptamt, which was created in August 1940. Waffen-SS.subject: Applied Sciences
Waffen-SS.question: In _____, SS chief of staff Gottlob Berger approached Himmler with a plan to recruit volunteers in the conquered territories from the ethnic German and Germanic populations
Waffen-SS.fact: Himmler gained approval for the Waffen-SS to form its own high command, the Kommandoamt der Waffen-SS within the SS Führungshauptamt, which was created in August 1940. In 1940, SS chief of staff Gottlob Berger approached Himmler with a plan to recruit volunteers in the conquered territories from the ethnic German and Germanic populations.

Waffen-SS.subject: Applied Sciences
Waffen-SS.question: It received command of the SS-VT (the _____ and the Verfügungs-Division, renamed Reich) and the armed SS-TV regiments (the Totenkopf Division together with several independent Totenkopf-Standarten)
Waffen-SS.fact: It received command of the SS-VT (the Leibstandarte and the Verfügungs-Division, renamed Reich) and the armed SS-TV regiments (the Totenkopf Division together with several independent Totenkopf-Standarten).

Waffen-SS.subject: Applied Sciences
Waffen-SS.question: At first, _____ had doubts about recruiting foreigners, but he was persuaded by Himmler and Berger
Waffen-SS.fact: At first, Hitler had doubts about recruiting foreigners, but he was persuaded by Himmler and Berger.

Waffen-SS.subject: Applied Sciences
Waffen-SS.question: He gave approval for a new division to be formed from foreign nationals with _____ officers
Waffen-SS.fact: In 1940, SS chief of staff Gottlob Berger approached Himmler with a plan to recruit volunteers in the conquered territories from the ethnic German and Germanic populations. He gave approval for a new division to be formed from foreign nationals with German officers.

Waffen-SS.subject: Applied Sciences
Waffen-SS.question: By June _____, Danish and Norwegian volunteers had formed the SS Regiment Nordland, with Dutch and Flemish volunteers forming the SS Regiment Westland
Waffen-SS.fact: In 1940, SS chief of staff Gottlob Berger approached Himmler with a plan to recruit volunteers in the conquered territories from the ethnic German and Germanic populations. By June 1940, Danish and Norwegian volunteers had formed the SS Regiment Nordland, with Dutch and Flemish volunteers forming the SS Regiment Westland.

Waffen-SS.subject: Applied Sciences
Waffen-SS.question: The two regiments, together with _____ (transferred from the Reich Division), formed the SS Division Wiking
Waffen-SS.fact: The two regiments, together with Germania (transferred from the Reich Division), formed the SS Division Wiking. The 11th Regiment was transferred into the Reich Division to replace Germania; the remainder were grouped into three independent brigades and a battle group in Norway.

Waffen-SS.subject: Applied Sciences
Waffen-SS.question: A sufficient number of volunteers came forward requiring the SS to open a new training camp just for foreign volunteers at _____ in Alsace-Lorraine
Waffen-SS.fact: A sufficient number of volunteers came forward requiring the SS to open a new training camp just for foreign volunteers at Sennheim in Alsace-Lorraine.

Waffen-SS.subject: Applied Sciences
Waffen-SS.question: The 11th _____ was transferred into the Reich Division to replace Germania; the remainder were grouped into three independent brigades and a battle group in Norway
Waffen-SS.fact: The two regiments, together with Germania (transferred from the Reich Division), formed the SS Division Wiking. At the same time, the Totenkopf-Standarten, aside from the three constituting the TK-Division, lost their Death's Head designation and insignia and were reclassified SS-Infanterie- (or Kavallerie-) Regimente.

Waffen-SS.subject: Applied Sciences
Waffen-SS.question: Operation Marita began on 6 April _____, with German troops invading Greece through Bulgaria and Yugoslavia in an effort to secure its southern flank
Waffen-SS.fact: By spring of 1941, the Waffen-SS consisted of the equivalent of six or seven divisions: the Reich, Totenkopf, Polizei, and Wiking Divisions and Kampfgruppe (later Division) Nord, the Leibstandarte, the 1st SS Infantry, 2nd SS Infantry and SS Cavalry Brigades. Operation Marita began on 6 April 1941, with German troops invading Greece through Bulgaria and Yugoslavia in an effort to secure its southern flank.

Waffen-SS.subject: Applied Sciences
Waffen-SS.question: Reich was ordered to leave _____ and head for Romania, and the Leibstandarte was ordered to Bulgaria
Waffen-SS.fact: Reich was ordered to leave France and head for Romania, and the Leibstandarte was ordered to Bulgaria.

Waffen-SS.subject: Applied Sciences
Waffen-SS.question: The Leibstandarte, attached to the XL Panzer Corps, advanced west then south from Bulgaria into the mountains, and by 9 April had reached Prilep in Yugoslavia, _____ from the Greek border
Waffen-SS.fact: The Leibstandarte, attached to the XL Panzer Corps, advanced west then south from Bulgaria into the mountains, and by 9 April had reached Prilep in Yugoslavia, 30 miles from the Greek border.

Waffen-SS.subject: Applied Sciences
Waffen-SS.question: Further north the _____, with the XLI Panzer Corps, crossed the Romanian border and advanced on Belgrade, the Yugoslav capital
Waffen-SS.fact: Further north the Reich Division, with the XLI Panzer Corps, crossed the Romanian border and advanced on Belgrade, the Yugoslav capital.

Waffen-SS.subject: Applied Sciences
Waffen-SS.question: Fritz Klingenberg, a company commander in the Reich, led his men into _____, where a small group in the vanguard accepted the surrender of the city on 13 April
Waffen-SS.fact: Further north the Reich Division, with the XLI Panzer Corps, crossed the Romanian border and advanced on Belgrade, the Yugoslav capital. Fritz Klingenberg, a company commander in the Reich, led his men into Belgrade, where a small group in the vanguard accepted the surrender of the city on 13 April.

Waffen-SS.subject: Applied Sciences
Waffen-SS.question: A few days later the _____ surrendered
Waffen-SS.fact: A few days later the Royal Yugoslav Army surrendered.

Waffen-SS.subject: Applied Sciences
Waffen-SS.question: The Leibstandarte had now crossed into Greece, and on 10 April engaged the 6th _____ in the Battle of the Klidi Pass
Waffen-SS.fact: The Leibstandarte had now crossed into Greece, and on 10 April engaged the 6th Australian Division in the Battle of the Klidi Pass.

Waffen-SS.subject: Applied Sciences
Waffen-SS.question: The next day, Meyer captured _____ and took another 11,000 prisoners of war
Waffen-SS.fact: The next day, Meyer captured Kastoria and took another 11,000 prisoners of war.

Waffen-SS.subject: Applied Sciences
Waffen-SS.question: By 20 May, the _____ had cut off the retreating Greek Army at Metsovo and accepted the surrender of the Greek Epirus-Macedonian Army
Waffen-SS.fact: This victory gained praise from the OKW: in the order of the day they were commended for their "unshakable offensive spirit" and told that "the present victory signifies for the Leibstandarte a new and imperishable page of honour in its history." The Leibstandarte continued the advance on 13 May. By 20 May, the Leibstandarte had cut off the retreating Greek Army at Metsovo and accepted the surrender of the Greek Epirus-Macedonian Army.

Waffen-SS.subject: Applied Sciences
Waffen-SS.question: By the end of _____, Nord had suffered severe casualties
Waffen-SS.fact: By the end of 1941, Nord had suffered severe casualties. Over the winter of 1941–42 it received replacements from the general pool of Waffen-SS recruits, who were supposedly younger and better trained than the SS men of the original formation, which had been drawn largely from Totenkopfstandarten of Nazi concentration camp guards.

Waffen-SS.subject: Applied Sciences
Waffen-SS.question: The Totenkopf and _____ divisions were attached to Army Group North, with the mission to advance through the Baltic states and on to Leningrad
Waffen-SS.fact: The Totenkopf and Polizei divisions were attached to Army Group North, with the mission to advance through the Baltic states and on to Leningrad.

Waffen-SS.subject: Applied Sciences
Waffen-SS.question: The Das Reich Division was with _____ and headed towards Moscow
Waffen-SS.fact: The Das Reich Division was with Army Group Centre and headed towards Moscow.

Waffen-SS.subject: Applied Sciences
Waffen-SS.question: The Leibstandarte and _____ were with Army Group South, heading for Ukraine and the city of Kiev
Waffen-SS.fact: The Leibstandarte and Wiking Divisions were with Army Group South, heading for Ukraine and the city of Kiev.

Waffen-SS.subject: Applied Sciences
Waffen-SS.question: Das Reich lost _____ of its strength and was still to take part in the Battle of Moscow
Waffen-SS.fact: Das Reich lost 60% of its strength and was still to take part in the Battle of Moscow.

Waffen-SS.subject: Applied Sciences
Waffen-SS.question: The unit was later decimated in the following _____ offensive
Waffen-SS.fact: The invasion of the Soviet Union proceeded well at first, but the cost to the Waffen-SS was extreme: by late October, the Leibstandarte was at half strength due to enemy action and dysentery that swept through the ranks. The unit was later decimated in the following Soviet offensive.

Waffen-SS.subject: Applied Sciences
Waffen-SS.question: The Der Führer _____ was reduced to 35 men out of the 2,000 that had started the campaign in June
Waffen-SS.fact: The Der Führer Regiment was reduced to 35 men out of the 2,000 that had started the campaign in June.

Waffen-SS.subject: Applied Sciences
Waffen-SS.question: While the _____ and the SS divisions were fighting in the front line, behind the lines it was a different story
Waffen-SS.fact: While the Leibstandarte and the SS divisions were fighting in the front line, behind the lines it was a different story.

Waffen-SS.subject: Applied Sciences
Waffen-SS.question: The 1st SS Infantry and 2nd SS _____, which had been formed from surplus concentration camp guards of the SS-TV, and the SS Cavalry Brigade moved into the Soviet Union behind the advancing armies
Waffen-SS.fact: The 1st SS Infantry and 2nd SS Infantry Brigades, which had been formed from surplus concentration camp guards of the SS-TV, and the SS Cavalry Brigade moved into the Soviet Union behind the advancing armies.

Waffen-SS.subject: Applied Sciences
Waffen-SS.question: In the autumn of _____, they left the anti-partisan role to other units and actively took part in the Holocaust
Waffen-SS.fact: At first, they fought Soviet partisans and cut off units of the Red Army in the rear of Army Group South, capturing 7,000 prisoners of war, but from mid-August 1941 until late 1942 they were assigned to the Reich Security Main Office headed by Reinhard Heydrich. In the autumn of 1941, they left the anti-partisan role to other units and actively took part in the Holocaust.

Waffen-SS.subject: Applied Sciences
Waffen-SS.question: While assisting the _____, they participated in the extermination of the Jewish population of the Soviet Union, forming firing parties when required
Waffen-SS.fact: While assisting the Einsatzgruppen, they participated in the extermination of the Jewish population of the Soviet Union, forming firing parties when required.

Waffen-SS.subject: Applied Sciences
Waffen-SS.question: The three brigades were responsible for the murder of tens of thousands by the end of _____
Waffen-SS.fact: In the autumn of 1941, they left the anti-partisan role to other units and actively took part in the Holocaust. The three brigades were responsible for the murder of tens of thousands by the end of 1941.

Waffen-SS.subject: Applied Sciences
Waffen-SS.question: In the summer of _____, Himmler assigned Hermann Fegelein to be in charge of both regiments
Waffen-SS.fact: The three brigades were responsible for the murder of tens of thousands by the end of 1941. In the summer of 1941, Himmler assigned Hermann Fegelein to be in charge of both regiments.

Waffen-SS.subject: Applied Sciences
Waffen-SS.question: Fegelein split the territory to be covered into two sections divided by the _____, with the 1st Regiment taking the northern half and the 2nd Regiment the south
Waffen-SS.fact: Fegelein split the territory to be covered into two sections divided by the Pripyat River, with the 1st Regiment taking the northern half and the 2nd Regiment the south.

Waffen-SS.subject: Applied Sciences
Waffen-SS.question: By 1 August, 1st SS _____ under the command of Gustav Lombard was responsible for the death of 800 people; by 6 August, this total had reached 3,000 "Jews and partisans"
Waffen-SS.fact: By 1 August, 1st SS Cavalry Regiment under the command of Gustav Lombard was responsible for the death of 800 people; by 6 August, this total had reached 3,000 "Jews and partisans".

Waffen-SS.subject: Applied Sciences
Waffen-SS.question: Throughout the following weeks, the regiment's personnel under _____'s command murdered an estimated 11,000 Jews and more than 400 dispersed soldiers of the Red Army
Waffen-SS.fact: By 1 August, 1st SS Cavalry Regiment under the command of Gustav Lombard was responsible for the death of 800 people; by 6 August, this total had reached 3,000 "Jews and partisans". Throughout the following weeks, the regiment's personnel under Lombard's command murdered an estimated 11,000 Jews and more than 400 dispersed soldiers of the Red Army.

Waffen-SS.subject: Applied Sciences
Waffen-SS.question: Fegelein's final operational report dated 18 September _____, states that they killed 14,178 Jews, 1,001 partisans, 699 Red Army soldiers, with 830 prisoners taken and losses of 17 dead, 36 wounded, a
Waffen-SS.fact: Fegelein's final operational report dated 18 September 1941, states that they killed 14,178 Jews, 1,001 partisans, 699 Red Army soldiers, with 830 prisoners taken and losses of 17 dead, 36 wounded, and 3 missing.

Waffen-SS.subject: Applied Sciences
Waffen-SS.question: By the second half of _____, an increasing number of foreigners, many of whom were not volunteers, began entering the ranks
Waffen-SS.fact: By the second half of 1942, an increasing number of foreigners, many of whom were not volunteers, began entering the ranks.

Waffen-SS.subject: Applied Sciences
Waffen-SS.question: Himmler approved the introduction of formal compulsory service for the _____ in German-occupied Serbia
Waffen-SS.fact: The 7th SS Volunteer Mountain Division Prinz Eugen was recruited from Volksdeutsche (ethnic Germans) drafted under threat of punishment by the local German leadership from Croatia, Serbia, Hungary, and Romania and used for anti-partisan operations in the Balkans. Himmler approved the introduction of formal compulsory service for the Volksdeutsche in German-occupied Serbia.

Waffen-SS.subject: Applied Sciences
Waffen-SS.question: Another new division was formed at the same time, when the SS _____ was used as the cadre in the formation of the 8th SS Cavalry Division Florian Geyer
Waffen-SS.fact: Another new division was formed at the same time, when the SS Cavalry Brigade was used as the cadre in the formation of the 8th SS Cavalry Division Florian Geyer.

Waffen-SS.subject: Applied Sciences
Waffen-SS.question: They each received nine _____ tanks, which were formed into the heavy panzer companies
Waffen-SS.fact: They each received nine Tiger tanks, which were formed into the heavy panzer companies.

Waffen-SS.subject: Applied Sciences
Waffen-SS.question: The Red Army liberated Demyansk on 1 March _____ with the retreat of German troops
Waffen-SS.fact: The Red Army liberated Demyansk on 1 March 1943 with the retreat of German troops.

Waffen-SS.subject: Applied Sciences
Waffen-SS.question: "For his excellence in command and the particularly fierce fighting of the Totenkopf", Eicke was awarded Oak Leaves to the Knight's Cross on 20 May _____
Waffen-SS.fact: "For his excellence in command and the particularly fierce fighting of the Totenkopf", Eicke was awarded Oak Leaves to the Knight's Cross on 20 May 1942.

Waffen-SS.subject: Applied Sciences
Waffen-SS.question: They were followed in July by the 11th SS _____ created from Norwegian and Danish volunteers
Waffen-SS.fact: They were followed in July by the 11th SS Volunteer Panzergrenadier Division Nordland created from Norwegian and Danish volunteers.

Waffen-SS.subject: Applied Sciences
Waffen-SS.question: September saw the formation of the 12th SS _____ using volunteers from the Hitler Youth
Waffen-SS.fact: September saw the formation of the 12th SS Panzer Division Hitlerjugend using volunteers from the Hitler Youth.

Waffen-SS.subject: Applied Sciences
Waffen-SS.question: The 12th SS _____ had lost 94 per cent of its armour, nearly all of its artillery, and 70 per cent of its vehicles
Waffen-SS.fact: September saw the formation of the 12th SS Panzer Division Hitlerjugend using volunteers from the Hitler Youth.

Waffen-SS.subject: Applied Sciences
Waffen-SS.question: This was followed by the 14th _____ of the SS (1st Galician) formed from volunteers from Galicia in western Ukraine
Waffen-SS.fact: This was followed by the 14th Waffen Grenadier Division of the SS (1st Galician) formed from volunteers from Galicia in western Ukraine. The 15th Waffen Grenadier Division of the SS (1st Latvian) was created in 1943, using compulsory military service in the Ostland.

Waffen-SS.subject: Applied Sciences
Waffen-SS.question: The 15th Waffen Grenadier Division of the SS (1st Latvian) was created in _____, using compulsory military service in the Ostland
Waffen-SS.fact: The 15th Waffen Grenadier Division of the SS (1st Latvian) was created in 1943, using compulsory military service in the Ostland. Waffen-SS.subject: Applied Sciences
Waffen-SS.question: The final new division of _____ was the 16th SS Panzergrenadier Division Reichsführer-SS, which was created using the Sturmbrigade Reichsführer SS as a cadre
Waffen-SS.fact: The 15th Waffen Grenadier Division of the SS (1st Latvian) was created in 1943, using compulsory military service in the Ostland. The final new division of 1943 was the 16th SS Panzergrenadier Division Reichsführer-SS, which was created using the Sturmbrigade Reichsführer SS as a cadre.

Waffen-SS.subject: Applied Sciences
Waffen-SS.question: By _____ the Waffen-SS could no longer claim to be an "elite" fighting force
Waffen-SS.fact: The 15th Waffen Grenadier Division of the SS (1st Latvian) was created in 1943, using compulsory military service in the Ostland. The final new division of 1943 was the 16th SS Panzergrenadier Division Reichsführer-SS, which was created using the Sturmbrigade Reichsführer SS as a cadre.

Waffen-SS.subject: Applied Sciences
Waffen-SS.question: Hitler ordered the SS _____ back to the Eastern Front for a counter-attack with the city of Kharkov as its objective
Waffen-SS.fact: Hitler ordered the SS Panzer Corps back to the Eastern Front for a counter-attack with the city of Kharkov as its objective. The SS Panzer Corps was in full retreat on 19 February, having been attacked by the Soviet 6th Army, when they received the order to counter-attack.

Waffen-SS.subject: Applied Sciences
Waffen-SS.question: The SS _____ was in full retreat on 19 February, having been attacked by the Soviet 6th Army, when they received the order to counter-attack
Waffen-SS.fact: Hitler ordered the SS Panzer Corps back to the Eastern Front for a counter-attack with the city of Kharkov as its objective. The SS Panzer Corps was in full retreat on 19 February, having been attacked by the Soviet 6th Army, when they received the order to counter-attack.

Waffen-SS.subject: Applied Sciences
Waffen-SS.question: Despite orders to encircle _____ from the north, the SS Panzer Corps directly attacked in the Third Battle of Kharkov on 11 March
Waffen-SS.fact: During Field Marshal Erich von Manstein's counteroffensive, the SS Panzer Corps, without support from the Luftwaffe or neighbouring German formations, broke through the Soviet line and advanced on Kharkov. Despite orders to encircle Kharkov from the north, the SS Panzer Corps directly attacked in the Third Battle of Kharkov on 11 March.

Waffen-SS.subject: Applied Sciences
Waffen-SS.question: This led to four days of house-to-house fighting before Kharkov was recaptured by the _____ on 15 March
Waffen-SS.fact: This led to four days of house-to-house fighting before Kharkov was recaptured by the Leibstandarte Division on 15 March.

Waffen-SS.subject: Applied Sciences
Waffen-SS.question: Two days later, the Germans recaptured Belgorod, creating the salient that, in July _____, led to the Battle of Kursk
